title: Marina Rescue Helpers
hook: Trained rescue comes before brave pretending.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
responseSpace: one to two predictable beats of retrieval space before target confirmation
visualStyle: friendly 3D boat-and-harbor storybook, calm water, clean civilian watercraft; visual identity: Marina Rescue Helpers

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child learning rescue-system roles from shore
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Repair Marina Rescue Helpers into a rescue-readiness lesson: lifeboat, navigation lights, marina/dock, voyage map, echo sounder and flotation craft support safety, while submarine and underwater scooter are specialized comparison equipment.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child identifies who/what supports rescue without pretending every boat is a rescue boat or inviting children to perform rescues.
